title: SpearDamageCap
description: Limit spear damage to a configurable cap.
body:
# SpearDamageCap

**SpearDamageCap** is a lightweight plugin for Paper servers running 1.21.11+ that limits how much damage a spear can deal to any entity, regardless of armor.

Whether you're running a balanced PvP server or just want to prevent netherite spears from one-shotting players — SpearDamageCap gives you a single configurable cap that enforces a hard limit on hearts lost per spear hit.

No complicated setup. Drop it in, set your cap, done.

---

## Features
- Set the cap **in-game or via config** — no restart needed
- Optional **notify message** sent to the attacker when their damage is capped
- All messages **fully configurable**
- Simple toggle to **enable or disable** the cap entirely

---

## Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `/speardamagecap value <number>` | Set the damage cap | `speardamagecap.admin` |
| `/speardamagecap reload` | Reload the config | `speardamagecap.admin` |

---

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `speardamagecap.admin` | Access to all commands | OP |

---

## Installation

1. Drop `speardamagecap-1.0.0.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
2. Start or reload your server
3. Edit `plugins/SpearDamageCap/config.yml` to configure your cap
4. Run `/speardamagecap reload` to apply changes
